assessment.report:
# Adaptive concurrency readiness

Bounded scope: raise the optional recommended child-thread ceiling from three to six, excluding Lead; normal two-to-three guidance is not a minimum. Medium and large work may increase concurrency only for ready independent tasks with distinct outputs, explicit write boundaries and integration. Respect actual enforced capacity even below source recommendation; no recursive delegation, forced quota, premature dependent work, weakened role/review obligations, global configuration edit or model change is authorized.

The Lead read repository instructions, complete README pair, architecture/release rules and shared role, ownership, execution, testing, TDD and comment contracts. Default inventory boundaries remain unchanged; out-of-scope designs/results remain preserved and are not re-certified. Chinese README/changelog, config, Skills and focused tests outside default inventory are explicit dependencies. No applicable product PRD or OpenSpec opt-in governs this repository maintenance task. Existing structure is adequate; no Blueprint amendment or source reorganization is needed.

Ownership: docs maintainer owns canonical role routing, team-dev/team-review step routes and paired public summaries/release item; backend owns only optional recommended config; Tester owns focused isolated config tests and the canonical packet; independent Reviewer inspects the coherent final implementation. These exact roles exist in the active tool catalog. Initial two child creation calls used team-tester and team-docs-maintainer; backend creation was rejected by capacity with no ID. Queue the same named role when available, without generic fallback. Tool-selected role and handle are not independently resolved model identity.

The official configuration guide confirms open spawned-child-thread semantics and primary exclusion. Source cap6 does not prove host availability or immediate activation. Test runs use repeatable programmatic entrypoints and summary-first results, with fixture cleanup; real-agent six-thread behavior and user acceptance remain pending. No exact personal paths are published. This readiness review binds inspected facts and sufficient approved scope, not global correctness, execution guarantees or manual acceptance.

The Lead inspected the complete Tester-created packet and narrow configuration test before writer authorization. AC-01 is an observable source-fragment test-first check, not a resolved Codex configuration test. AC-02 through AC-06 include explicit runtime checkpoints/manual mapping; semantic walkthroughs do not become E2E passes.
